description: Figure 10 is a line plot that illustrates the model's evaluation Perplexity (PPL) under different sparsity settings applied to the Attention and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) components at varying ratios. The horizontal axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The vertical axis, labeled "Eval PPL," is a linear scale ranging from 10 to 14, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The plot contains two distinct lines: a solid black line representing the model with sparsity applied to the Attention component, and a dashed red line representing the model with sparsity applied to the FFN component. The solid black line starts at an Eval PPL of approximately 11.61 when the sparsity ratio is 0 and increases to a value of approximately 13.20 when the sparsity ratio reaches 100. The dashed red line starts at a lower Eval PPL of approximately 11.61 and increases to a value of approximately 14.31 at a sparsity ratio of 100.
